notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.content:
After two intense weeks of collecting feedback from our community, we made a big update on Guns 'N Runs:

- Casual Mode
- New checkpoint system (respawn in the same room you died)
- Support for Windows 7 and Mac (Linux coming soon) 
- Fixed some bugs

Thank you ♥ have fun

Statera Studio Team
